title: Curriculum Night at OSHS
summary: Presenting our robot and robotics program to parents and students at our school.
author: Nathan L
body: In collaboration with FRC team 4013 Clockwork Mania and FTC teams 17288 Rubber Bandits and 20344 Cattlebots, we showcased our robotics program to around 100 people that attended our school's (Orlando Science High School) curriculum night.

body.caption: Around a hundred people came through over the evening.
Last season's banners hung behind the demo area.

body: Our demo included driving and shooting the worlds robot from last year and explaining the role our team plays in the greater community.

title: BioBuzz Kickoff!!
summary: Watching the release of the new FTC game this year and prototyping design plans.
author: Nathan L
body: Our school hosted a kickoff this year, like we do every year. The day started off with workshops for primarily the new members in our program, but they are useful for everyone. After the series of workshops, we watched the official game reveal... The game this year is crazy, but that's how it always feels like at the beginning of the season.

body.alt: Two members at a computer in the shop during a workshop, a field element panel in front of them
body.caption: Workshops in the morning, game reveal after.

body: After the game reveal, we split up into subteams to make a better use of our time. It is very important to understand the game, so before prototyping, we got some people to read the whole manual. Then, we discussed priorities and realized that at the start of the game, there is a 98% chance we would either collect 4 pollen or 3 pollen and 1 nectar. [Here](biobuzz-calculator.html) is a calculator for the chances of each scenario for BioBuzz.

body.alt: Members talking across a desk in a classroom, one holding a yellow game ball
body.caption: Subteams split up right after the reveal.

figures.alt: Members sitting on desks reading the game manual on laptops
figures.caption: Reading the manual end to end.

figures.alt: Two members bent over a sheet of paper working through numbers with a pen
figures.caption: Working out the starting odds on paper.

body: Then, we discussed possible designs and made a gantt chart. This gives us a plan to follow as we start off the season!

figures.alt: A circle of team members standing and talking through design ideas
figures.caption: Talking designs before anything got drawn.

figures.alt: A member sketching a mechanism on lined paper beside an open laptop
figures.caption: And then drawing them.

body.alt: The team posed together in the school lobby in matching light blue hoodies
body.caption: Day one of the season.
